services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Fly fishing in Key West is all about the challenge of presenting lightweight flies to fish in shallow, clear water. It’s an active approach to fishing, requiring accurate casts and an understanding of fish behaviour. The flats are home to species like bonefish, tarpon, and permit, making them the perfect setting for anglers who enjoy a technical and rewarding style of fishing. Practising your cast before the trip is highly recommended to increase your chances of success, and casting lessons with a professional instructor can be arranged upon request.
